messages:
Ana (Marketing): Hey team — quick heads up: PeregrineAI agreed to a short case study + a 30-min customer webinar. Need interview scheduling, quote sign-off, and legal review. Timeline: want landing + blog + social live by next Thu. Can folks chime in availability? :rocket:

Jamal (Sales): Woo! Good news. I'm available Tue/Wed mornings. Can do customer intro on Mon if needed. Also need to route inbound leads from webinar to AE queue — I'll sync with @Lina.

Lina (PM): I can own the registration page and CTAs. Jamal, can you confirm lead fields we need? Also suggest gating with company size + use-case so we route properly.

Molly (Design): I'll draft hero image + 3 social cards. ETA EOD Fri for review. Any brand kit requirements from Peregrine?

Ana (Marketing): Peregrine sent a logo and short 1-liner. I'll paste quote they offered below for redlines:

```
"Redwood helped PeregrineAI cut inference cost by 42% while improving p99 latency — the difference was night-and-day for our user flows."
```

Ryan (Legal): I'll review quote language — flagging "night-and-day" as subjective. Ask them for permission to use that phrasing; otherwise we should amend to a measurable claim or add "according to Peregrine." Also need a signed marketing release. I'll draft a release template and ping them.

Ana (Marketing): Noted. @Ryan (Legal) can you share the release by EOD? Also do we have a canonical webinar recording consent checkbox for republishing?

Ryan (Legal): Yes, I'll include a checkbox clause for recording & redistribution. Sending draft in a few hours.

Jamal (Sales): For lead routing: prefer auto-assign to AE team if company_size >= 50 or ARR >= 1M. Otherwise go to inbound SDR queue. Can we add a hidden field for account_health? (we have a pre-score)

Lina (PM): Good plan. For webinar ops: proposed dates Wed 10am PT or Thu 11am PT. Which works better for EMEA attendance? Also what time for rehearsal?

Molly (Design): Wed 10am PT fine. Rehearsal 30min before. I'll prep slides template.

Ana (Marketing): Ok locking Wed 10am PT. Action items:
- Jamal: confirm lead routing rules + hidden fields (due: Tue)
- Ryan: draft marketing release + quote language check (due: today)
- Molly: creative + slide template (due: Fri)
- Lina: registration + CTAs (due: Tue)
- Ana: collect final quote and schedule interview w/ Peregrine (due: Mon)

Kiwi Bot: Deployment reminder — set webinar landing page UTM params: utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=peregrine_launch

Ana (Marketing): Anyone object to launching blog + short benchmark narrative + webinar landing together? Would like to cross-promote on LinkedIn/Sequence.

Ryan (Legal): No objections once release signed.

Jamal (Sales): 👍 from me. Will prep AE follow-up snippet for post-webinar.

Lina (PM): I'll add canary CTA experiment in registration: two CTAs, track conversion.

Ana (Marketing): Perfect. I'll send a short agenda + pre-interview list of questions to Peregrine today. Thanks all :pray:
